name: Charge Limit
author: k7cfo
description: A battery toolbar button: conserve at 80%, or hold a full charge until unplugged.

barWidget.description: Battery with an up arrow for full charge or a down arrow for conservation. Click to choose.

schema.label: Battery-life cap (%)
schema.description: Where charging stops for everyday use. 80% is the usual laptop conservation stop. Start threshold is 5 points below, so the pack does not micro-cycle at the cap.
